entries.german:
`Aufzeichnung über die Rechte des Erzbisthums Mainz in der Stadt Osterburken.

1668.

[26.] Die jagens gerechtigkeit. gleichwoblen hat herr ertzbischof Wolfgang christseeligsten andenckhenß weiland Albrecht Christoph von Rosenberg besag deß [vertrags] in anno 1596 den 20 martii daß hetzen vom strickh aus auf der gantzen Burckheimer gemarkhung von Bartholomei bis auf cathedra Petri⁵ erlaubt. auch ist ihme vermög obangeregtes vertrags daß mitjagen in dem Kalben den Schneidtweege⁶ hinaus bis an das Bohtßheimer⁷ holtz eingeräumt worden. anietzo exerciren solches die grafen von Hatzfeld.`
entries.english:
Record concerning the rights of the Archdiocese of Mainz in the town of Osterburken.

1668.

[26.] The right of hunting. Nevertheless, the late Lord Archbishop Wolfgang, of blessed memory, granted to Albrecht Christoph von Rosenberg, pursuant to the [contract] of March 20, 1596, the right to hunt with hounds throughout the entire Burckheim district from St. Bartholomew's Day to Cathedra Petri. Moreover, by virtue of the aforementioned contract, he was granted the right to join the hunt in the Kalben area, via the Schneidtweege path up to the Bohtsheim woods. This is now exercised by the Counts of Hatzfeld.

facts.content: was permitted to hunt throughout the Burckheim district from St. Bartholomew’s Day to Cathedra Petri under an agreement.
was granted the right to join the hunt in the Kalben area, from the Schneidtweege to the Bohtsheim woods.
